title: Angie Dewoody Mitchell Delivers a Gripping Story of Faith Healing and Second Chances in Protecting Faith | User | ridgwayrecord.com
text:
Angie Dewoody Mitchell introduces readers to a powerful story of emotional resilience and divine guidance in her new novel Protecting Faith . Blending suspense, heartfelt emotion, and spiritual depth, the book follows a woman rebuilding her life after trauma and discovering love and purpose through faith.
A Story of Courage, Escape, and God’s Restoring Grace
Protecting Faith centers on Pre-K teacher Faith Roberts, a woman running from a dangerous past that has left deep emotional scars. Keeping only her strong belief in God to hold her together, she tries to build a new life far from the control of Charles Meredith, her abusive ex fiancé who refuses to accept that she is gone. Charles has tracked her to her new hometown and secretly watches her from the shadows, convinced she still loves him.
As Faith starts over, she meets Officer Ryan Madsen, the new school security officer who is guarding his own painful past. Their connection grows slowly as they learn to break down their emotional barriers together. But Charles, whose grip on reality is slipping, becomes more violent and determined to destroy anyone who stands between him and Faith. What follows is a tense and emotional journey of survival, redemption, and love grounded in unwavering trust in God’s plan.
Guided by Faith and Personal Inspiration
Mitchell shares that the book carries elements of her own experiences. She describes the writing process as a spiritual journey shaped by a struggle within herself and the guidance of the Holy Spirit.
“I wrote the book because it has elements of myself in it, and I just had these ideas,” she explains. “There was a bit of a struggle with me and the Holy Spirit, and it took me a while to write it the way God wanted me to write it. But once I started listening to God, the book came quite quickly.”
A Message of Hope and New Beginnings
The core message of Protecting Faith reflects Mitchell’s belief in divine compassion and renewal. She hopes readers will be reminded that God offers second chances, understands every struggle, and always has the best in mind for His children even when the path is unclear.
About the Author
Angie Dewoody Mitchell is a Christian fiction author who brings emotional honesty and spiritual encouragement to her storytelling. She is also the author of Just Breathe, another faith centered novel that reflects her heart for uplifting narratives. Mitchell’s writing continues to inspire readers who seek stories of healing, hope, and God’s unwavering love.
Book Availability
Protecting Faith is available through major online retailers. To learn more about Angie Dewoody Mitchell and her work, readers can visit her website at Adewoodymitchell.wordpress.com.
